# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand.
#   python tools/generate_ladders.py
#
# Cabinet advancement ladders. Each ladder is one career; a rung's index is the
# track tier required to reach it. Replaces the five hand-written chains that
# used to live in cc_progression_events.txt as cc_prog.1-40.
#
#   15 ladders, 55 rungs, 9 branch points
#   [adm] reform: fumbling_reformist -> law_reformer -> progressive_reformist -> master_reformer
#   [adm] fiscal: clumsy_accountant -> loyal_steward -> prosperity_planner|treasury_enforcer -> development_patron
#   [adm] learning: learned_courtier -> learned_counselor -> progressive_rationalist -> enlightenment_herald|humanist_philosopher
#   [adm] urbanism: urban_planner -> master_urbanist -> grand_architect
#   [adm] law: legal_scholar -> efficiency_administrator -> estate_guardian|regional_magnate
#   [adm] integration: fumbling_integrator -> able_integrator -> seasoned_integrator -> master_integrator|iron_integrator
#   [dip] envoy: tentative_envoy -> tactful_envoy|diplomatic_attache -> master_statesman -> grand_chancellor
#   [dip] colonial: frontier_administrator -> new_world_pioneer -> colonial_planner -> returned_colonial_governor
#   [dip] trade: merchant_syndic -> mercantilist_official|free_market_advocate -> maritime_champion -> merchant_prince
#   [dip] exploration: timid_landlubber -> capable_explorer -> restless_pioneer -> admiral_counselor
#   [dip] intrigue: provocateur -> espionage_director -> shadow_counselor
#   [mil] command: green_adjutant -> tactical_advisor -> offensive_strategist|defensive_commander -> supreme_commander|continental_marshal
#   [mil] drill: infantry_drillmaster -> elite_trainer -> iron_disciplinarian -> mass_levy_commander
#   [mil] siege: military_engineer -> siege_engineer -> commissariat_officer
#   [mil] cavalry: scout_captain -> master_of_horse -> cavalry_marshal
#
# Called in CHARACTER scope from cc_xp_yearly_advance (cc_xp_pulse.txt). Advances
# at most one rung per call: the if/else_if chain stops at the first match, and the
# cooldown stamped at the end keeps a minister who has banked several tiers from
# sprinting up the whole ladder in consecutive years.
#
# Branch rungs put the choice to the player through one event per branch point
# (cc_xp_branch_events.txt). AI courts still roll for it, so the pulse never stalls
# waiting on a decision nobody is there to make.
###############################################################################

		add_trait = trait:iron_disciplinarian
		remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
		cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = iron_disciplinarian
			cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 3 }
		}
		remove_trait = trait:iron_disciplinarian
		set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
		add_trait = trait:mass_levy_commander
		remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
		cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
	}

	# ---- siege (mil): The Engineer ----
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = military_engineer
			cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 1 }
		}
		remove_trait = trait:military_engineer
		set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
		add_trait = trait:siege_engineer
		remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
		cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = siege_engineer
			cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 2 }
		}
		remove_trait = trait:siege_engineer
		set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
		add_trait = trait:commissariat_officer
		remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
		cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
	}

	# ---- cavalry (mil): The Horse ----
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = scout_captain
			cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 1 }
		}
		remove_trait = trait:scout_captain
		set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
		add_trait = trait:master_of_horse
		remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
		cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = master_of_horse
			cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 2 }
		}
		remove_trait = trait:master_of_horse
		set_variable = { name = cc_granting_trait  value = yes }
		add_trait = trait:cavalry_marshal
		remove_variable = cc_granting_trait
		cc_xp_stamp_advance = yes
	}
}

###############################################################################
# Bookkeeping applied after any successful advancement. Split out so the chain
# above stays readable and so there is one place to add a notification later.
###############################################################################

cc_xp_stamp_advance = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_xp_advance_cd  value = yes  years = 4 }
	set_variable = { name = cc_xp_advanced_recently  value = yes  months = 2 }
}

###############################################################################
# ONE-TIME SEEDING
#
# Called from cc_xp_init the first time a character enters the system. A minister
# who already holds a rung-N ladder trait is credited with enough experience in
# that track to sit at tier N, so they carry on from where their career actually
# is instead of restarting at zero.
#
# This is what carries an existing save across the phase 2 change. The old chains
# tracked progress in cc_prog_* counters that nothing reads any more; a minister
# who finished one is recognised here by the TRAIT they ended up with, which is
# the part that survived. Without it, a minister who spent twelve years becoming
# a progressive_reformist would need decades more to advance again.
#
# It also does the right thing for a fresh grant: a trait event that hands out a
# rung-2 trait directly leaves that minister correctly placed on the ladder.
#
# Floors rather than overwrites, so a minister who has genuinely earned more keeps it.
###############################################################################

cc_xp_ladder_backfill = {

	# adm rung 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = able_integrator
				has_trait = efficiency_administrator
				has_trait = law_reformer
				has_trait = learned_counselor
				has_trait = loyal_steward
				has_trait = master_urbanist
			}
			var:cc_xp_adm < cc_xp_tier_1_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_adm  value = cc_xp_tier_1_at }
	}

	# adm rung 2
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = estate_guardian
				has_trait = grand_architect
				has_trait = progressive_rationalist
				has_trait = progressive_reformist
				has_trait = prosperity_planner
				has_trait = regional_magnate
				has_trait = seasoned_integrator
				has_trait = treasury_enforcer
			}
			var:cc_xp_adm < cc_xp_tier_2_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_adm  value = cc_xp_tier_2_at }
	}

	# adm rung 3
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = development_patron
				has_trait = enlightenment_herald
				has_trait = humanist_philosopher
				has_trait = iron_integrator
				has_trait = master_integrator
				has_trait = master_reformer
			}
			var:cc_xp_adm < cc_xp_tier_3_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_adm  value = cc_xp_tier_3_at }
	}

	# dip rung 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = capable_explorer
				has_trait = diplomatic_attache
				has_trait = espionage_director
				has_trait = free_market_advocate
				has_trait = mercantilist_official
				has_trait = new_world_pioneer
				has_trait = tactful_envoy
			}
			var:cc_xp_dip < cc_xp_tier_1_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_dip  value = cc_xp_tier_1_at }
	}

	# dip rung 2
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = colonial_planner
				has_trait = maritime_champion
				has_trait = master_statesman
				has_trait = restless_pioneer
				has_trait = shadow_counselor
			}
			var:cc_xp_dip < cc_xp_tier_2_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_dip  value = cc_xp_tier_2_at }
	}

	# dip rung 3
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = admiral_counselor
				has_trait = grand_chancellor
				has_trait = merchant_prince
				has_trait = returned_colonial_governor
			}
			var:cc_xp_dip < cc_xp_tier_3_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_dip  value = cc_xp_tier_3_at }
	}

	# mil rung 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = elite_trainer
				has_trait = master_of_horse
				has_trait = siege_engineer
				has_trait = tactical_advisor
			}
			var:cc_xp_mil < cc_xp_tier_1_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_mil  value = cc_xp_tier_1_at }
	}

	# mil rung 2
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = cavalry_marshal
				has_trait = commissariat_officer
				has_trait = defensive_commander
				has_trait = iron_disciplinarian
				has_trait = offensive_strategist
			}
			var:cc_xp_mil < cc_xp_tier_2_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_mil  value = cc_xp_tier_2_at }
	}

	# mil rung 3
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = continental_marshal
				has_trait = mass_levy_commander
				has_trait = supreme_commander
			}
			var:cc_xp_mil < cc_xp_tier_3_at
		}
		set_variable = { name = cc_xp_mil  value = cc_xp_tier_3_at }
	}

	cc_xp_resum = yes
}

###############################################################################
# Recompute the stored total from the three tracks. Needed after any effect that
# writes a track variable directly instead of going through cc_xp_gain_*.
###############################################################################

cc_xp_resum = {
	set_variable    = { name = cc_xp_total  value = var:cc_xp_adm }
	change_variable = { name = cc_xp_total  add   = var:cc_xp_dip }
	change_variable = { name = cc_xp_total  add   = var:cc_xp_mil }
}

###############################################################################
# CAREER ENTRY
#
# Rung 0 used to be reachable only by the monthly trait dispatcher, which meant the
# player had no say at all in which of the fifteen careers a minister ended up on,
# and four ladders (reform, fiscal, envoy, exploration) were reachable by nothing:
# no event in the mod granted their entry trait.
#
# These effects are what fixes both. Called in CHARACTER scope from the training
# return events (cc_xp.30/.31/.32) when the returning minister holds no rung trait
# at all and the posting did not go badly. They stamp the flag the picker resolves
# its minister by and roll which careers are on the menu.
#
# The flag is timed rather than permanent so a picker the player somehow never sees
# expires instead of leaving a minister waiting forever. Two months is the same
# window cc_xp_branch_pending uses.
###############################################################################

# adm: 4 of 6 offered (reform, fiscal, learning, urbanism, law, integration)
cc_xp_offer_career_adm = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_xp_awaiting_career_adm  value = yes  months = 2 }
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 1  months = 2 } }   # reform fiscal learning urbanism
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 2  months = 2 } }   # fiscal learning urbanism law
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 3  months = 2 } }   # learning urbanism law integration
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 4  months = 2 } }   # reform urbanism law integration
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 5  months = 2 } }   # reform fiscal law integration
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 6  months = 2 } }   # reform fiscal learning integration
	}
}

# dip: 4 of 5 offered (envoy, colonial, trade, exploration, intrigue)
cc_xp_offer_career_dip = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_xp_awaiting_career_dip  value = yes  months = 2 }
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 1  months = 2 } }   # envoy colonial trade exploration
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 2  months = 2 } }   # colonial trade exploration intrigue
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 3  months = 2 } }   # envoy trade exploration intrigue
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 4  months = 2 } }   # envoy colonial exploration intrigue
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 5  months = 2 } }   # envoy colonial trade intrigue
	}
}

# mil: 3 of 4 offered (command, drill, siege, cavalry)
cc_xp_offer_career_mil = {
	set_variable = { name = cc_xp_awaiting_career_mil  value = yes  months = 2 }
	random_list = {
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 1  months = 2 } }   # command drill siege
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 2  months = 2 } }   # drill siege cavalry
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 3  months = 2 } }   # command siege cavalry
		1 = { set_variable = { name = cc_xp_career_offer  value = 4  months = 2 } }   # command drill cavalry
	}
}
